content: बकः .²1 The Indian crane; न प्रयत्नशतेनापि शुकवत् पाठ्यते बकः <ls>H.</ls> .²2 A cheat, rogue, hypocrite (the crane being a very cunning bird that knows well how to draw others into its clutches). .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon killed by Bhīma. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of another demon killed by Kṛṣṇa. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Kubera. .²6 An apparatus for subliming metals or minerals. .{@-की@} = पूतना <ab>q. v.</ab> अहो बकी यं स्तनकालकूटं जिघांसयापाययदप्यसाध्वी <ls>Bhāg. 3. 2. 23</ls>. .²2 A female crane.
